subject: Re: LumenAI trial — procurement & billing readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: trial next steps & procurement questions

Thanks again for the demo today, Alex — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps:

- Trial success criteria: 10k generated tokens/day with latency < 300ms p50 for our top 3 endpoints, integration of prefix caching for frequently used prompts.
- Product check: engineering will validate KV cache integration during week of 4/12.
- Commercial path: you mentioned procurement prefers PO for enterprise deals; want to confirm whether they will accept monthly invoicing via PO or require annual commitment.

Action items for LumenAI: please confirm (by EOD Thu) whether:
1) Procurement will issue POs (and the required billing contact and PO template), or whether the team will use company card to pay initially;
2) Whether you’re interested in listing Redwood on the Cloud Partner Marketplace (that would simplify billing for you).

I’ve attached a draft SOW and our standard SLA for procurement. If procurement wants a shorter renewal/start date window for billing after trial, flag that now so we can align.

Thanks — I’ll loop Rishi for pricing/comm options and Priyom for the SOW redlines.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@lumenai.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial next steps & procurement questions

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick answers from our side:

1) Procurement will require a PO for any invoices over $10k, but they are fine with month-to-month POs for pilot projects. They’ll need your W-9, standard Redwood invoice template, and our PO template (attached).
2) We can start on company card for initial evaluation if needed, but prefer PO if the pilot runs beyond 30 days.
3) Marketplace: yes, being on the cloud marketplace would be helpful — we need to check with our cloud procurement lead on timelines.

On success criteria — confirmed: our engineering team will try to hit the 10k token/day baseline; if we see stable performance we’ll move to a short A/B test with customer-facing models. If all good, target billing start date is the first day after the trial ends (we’ll let you know the exact end date once internal approvals finish).

Procurement (cc’d) — can you confirm the billing contact and any additional compliance docs you need?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of ML Engineering
LumenAI

From: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial next steps & procurement questions

Hi Marissa — procurement here (Sana). For POs we need: company legal name, tax ID (EIN), W-9 (US entities), invoice remittance address, and a copy of the SLA. Also please provide a standard Redwood invoice PDF and the bill-to contact and email. Our PO workflow usually takes 7-10 business days once we have docs.

If you can accept a PO with net-30, we can start with monthly POs during the pilot. Regarding marketplace listing, please send the partner onboarding doc and marketplace billing terms.

Best,
Sana Patel
Senior Procurement Analyst | LumenAI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@lumenai.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@lumenai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: trial next steps & procurement questions

Thanks, Sana — appreciate the clarity. Attached: W-9, Redwood_SLA_2027.pdf, sample invoice template, and the draft SOW (SOW-draft-lumenai.docx). I’ve also attached a short partner onboarding checklist for marketplace intake.

Quick notes:
- Redwood can accept PO with net-30 for pilot invoices.
- Billing start date: we typically start billing the day after the agreed trial end date. If LumenAI wants the first invoice to align to month boundaries, we can accommodate a billing start offset — let me know.
- Trial success threshold: if your team sustains >= 10k tokens/day for 5 consecutive business days and latency targets are met, we’ll mark the trial successful and prepare an invoice per the PO terms.

Next steps:
1) Sana — if you can confirm bill-to contact/email and return a signed PO template, Rishi will finalize pricing and issue the invoice schedule.
2) Alex — engineering sync on 4/12; please share any perf test windows.
3) Priyom — will own SOW redlines; I’ll route any legal asks through our contracts team.

Looking forward — happy to hop on a short call if procurement prefers.

—Marissa
